title: Producer/Director Masayasu Sagisu Dies at 93
content: There was a private funeral for family members. Sagisu was born in 1932 in Tokyo. He was the younger brother to director and producer Sōji Ushio (also known as Fujio Sagisu, Tomio Sagisu , and Shiro Sagisu 's father). Sagisu was a director and producer at Eiken , formerly known as TCJ Animation .
